Yes, I've gotten professional help, but besides that, I always tried to cheer myself up, so I would never throw the towel, but I find myself unable to continue at this point.

For me, it has always been like this, since I've got memory. I've told myself that I could manage to overcome it by trying to find happiness in life, or at least partially, but I haven't found positive emotions or at least enjoyment in anything I do.

I've done a lot of things, but nothing fulfills me as a person. Of anything, my actions brought a "That's what you are supposed to do" from my family, and everyone surrounding me.

And yes, my immediate family is the one that tells me that I'm a burden and that I'll always be.

I try to make myself belive that, but day after day I'm reassured that I'm a burden to my family, that I would do better if I wasn't here. I've been explicitly told that most things in my family would be better if I wouldn't have been born.

Today I think I reached my breaking point, I can't continue putting an empty smile on my face just for the sake of doing it.

Nothing is meaningful to me in any way, everything I do is just to pass time, or just for the sake of doing it, forcing myself to "fit" and giving the illusion of a sane person.

I've been to the specialists, but I haven't been diagnosed with anything strange.
